// diagnostic

E0108

`HookDecision.Fail` needs String (text), not Int (a whole number)

What

`HookDecision.Fail` needs String (text), not Int (a whole number)

Why

The decision payload must match the hook's declared payload or error type

Fix

Put the value in text with interpolation: "{x}"

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0108: tests/ui/cffi_callback_capture.stderr.

Error [E3203]: `fn(I32) I32 -[]>` is not a C-compatible type for a foreign function parameter or return.
  --> tests/ui/cffi_callback_capture.jet:9:18
    |
  9 |     print(c.call((x) -> x + offset, 40))
    |                  ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
 Why: `#Extern` / `#Bindgen` functions must use types with a stable C ABI at the edge.
 Fix: use scalars, `String`, or a struct with C layout; pointers only through the gated tier.
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E3203

Error [E0108]: this needs fn(I32) I32 -[]>, but the callable obligations are not satisfied
  --> tests/ui/cffi_callback_capture.jet:9:18
    |
  9 |     print(c.call((x) -> x + offset, 40))
    |                  ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
 Why: the callable value does not provide the obligations required here
 Fix: pass a callable with matching effects, labels, and view provenance
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0108
